title: Reporting Broken Volumetric Flasks & Pipette Tips
description: Foundational chemical laboratory module covering reporting broken volumetric flasks & pipette tips.
learning_objectives: Master professional Past Simple Negatives & Questions in organic API synthesis and QC analysis
Eliminate common Czech interference errors in reporting broken volumetric flasks & pipette tips
Demonstrate precision in HPLC, Karl Fischer, and pharmacopeial compliance documentation

questions.prompt: Yesterday afternoon in the synthesis lab, the analytical chemist _____ 5.0 grams of active pharmaceutical substance on the analytical balance.

explanations.correct: Specific completed past time 'Yesterday afternoon' strictly requires Past Simple 'weighed'.
explanations.wrong_A: Base form 'weigh' lacks past tense marking.
explanations.wrong_D: Present Continuous describes current actions, not yesterday's finished events.

questions.cz_learning_point: Czech uses the same past tense, but in English, 'yesterday' strictly triggers Past Simple ('weighed').
